description: Lets the app draw its own title bar. The window is loaded from http://127.0.0.1:41730 — a remote origin as far as the webview is concerned — so Tauri injects nothing into it by default and the page cannot move, minimise or close its own window. This grants exactly those, and nothing else: no filesystem, no shell, no HTTP. If the app were ever to serve someone else's script, the worst it could do with this is close a window.
